howto.what: 这个技能让Claude成为.NET 8后端专家，能帮你设计、实现和测试基于最小API、整洁架构或云原生微服务的应用程序。它会生成C#代码、配置项目结构，并确保代码遵循最佳实践。
howto.when: 当你提到“.NET Core”、“.NET 8”、“ASP.NET Core”、“C# 12”、“最小API”、“Entity Framework Core”、“微服务 .NET”、“CQRS”或“MediatR”等关键词时，或者要求构建相关后端应用时触发。

say.text: 帮我用.NET 8最小API创建一个用户CRUD接口。
为我的微服务项目添加JWT认证。
say.note: Claude会提供认证配置和授权策略。

say.text: 用Entity Framework Core设计数据库模型并生成迁移。
say.note: Claude会创建DbContext、实体类和迁移文件。

howto.what_en: This skill turns Claude into a .NET 8 backend expert, helping you design, implement, and test applications using minimal APIs, clean architecture, or cloud-native microservices. It generates C# code, configures project structure, and ensures best practices.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like '.NET Core', '.NET 8', 'ASP.NET Core', 'C# 12', 'minimal API', 'Entity Framework Core', 'microservices .NET', 'CQRS', or 'MediatR', or when you ask to build related backend applications.

say_en.text: Create a user CRUD API using .NET 8 minimal APIs.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Program.cs and related query/command handlers.

say_en.text: Add JWT authentication to my microservice project.
say_en.note: Claude will provide authentication configuration and authorization policies.

say_en.text: Design a database model with Entity Framework Core and generate migrations.
say_en.note: Claude will create DbContext, entities, and migration files.
